name: figma
description: Figma design-to-code, FigJam diagrams, and design-system workflows for NewBrain. Requires a connected Figma MCP server or FIGMA_ACCESS_TOKEN to write into Figma cloud files.

interface.shortDescription: Generate Figma designs and FigJam flowcharts
interface.longDescription: Use Figma MCP tools to create designs, FigJam flowcharts/architecture diagrams, and design-to-code workflows. Without Figma auth, fall back to Mermaid in chat or the Visualize plugin for local diagrams.
interface.defaultPrompt: 用 Figma 生成流程图或根据设计稿实现界面。
